**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement imposes no non-compete or business-scope restriction on us:

- **Article II restrictions (p0035, p0040–p0047) and the Field of Use definition (p0007)** are license-scope limits on how we may use *Licensor's* Licensed Technology (no out-of-scope use, no sublicense/distribution, no Derivative Works, no reverse engineering). They do not restrain our own FX or trading business, and nothing bars us from licensing, buying or building another platform.
- **Article VI (p0085)** is a sub-licensing prohibition on the Licensed Technology only.
- **Article X (p0125)** is an employee non-solicitation (three years post-term) running in Licensor's favour — a non-solicit, not a non-compete, and reviewed under the non-solicitation rule.
- **Change of Control (p0134) and the Right of First Refusal (p0139)** allow Licensor to withhold consent where an acquirer is competitive and to pre-empt a sale. These constrain our exit, not the businesses we may operate, so they belong to the change-of-control/assignment rules and are noted rather than double-flagged here.

Preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is satisfied, so no edit was proposed.
